newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volker Stevin sees major profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Volker Stevin sees major profit rise.

text.p: Construction firm Volker Stevin NV said on Tuesday it had raised its profit forecast for 1997 upwards.
"Based on present views, we expect the 1997 profit to be significantly higher than in the previous year," the company said in a statement.
It added that it also expected the 1997 net profit of the newly formed firm Volker Wessels Stevin to be substantially higher than the combined 1996 profits of the two merger partners.
Last March, Volker Stevin said it would merge with sector rival Kondor Wessels Groep.

In 1996, Volker Stevin posted net profits of 73 million guilders. Kondor Wessels had a net profit of 33.7 million guilders in the financial year 1995/96 and a net of 15.4 million in the first half of 1996/97.

Volker Stevin said it based its upbeat forecast on its sound and well-balanced order book. The planned takeover of part of the railway construction activities from state-owned Dutch Railways was also expected to affect favourably 1997 profits, it said.
